angle: The truth about wireless charging pads you don't need
hook: Stop right there before buying a wireless charging pad!
script: Stop right there before buying a wireless charging pad! Sure, they look sleek and promise convenience, but in our testing, most lose their charge if you even sneeze on them. Plus, they often take longer to juice up your device compared to a good old cable. Unless your nightstand is a charging shrine, save your cash. Follow for more!
caption_body: Thinking of getting a wireless charging pad? You might want to reconsider! 💰
